title: 素理想：乘积落入时至少一因子落入
Prime ideals detect factors
entries.tex: P\subsetneq R,\quad ab\in P\Rightarrow a\in P\ \text{or}\ b\in P
text: 在交换环中，素理想首先必须是真理想，再满足乘积判别。它把整数的“素数整除乘积”推广到理想。
In a commutative ring a prime ideal must be proper and satisfy the product criterion. It generalizes the divisibility property of prime integers.
example: ℤ 的素理想是 (0) 与 (p)（p 为素数）。(6) 不是素理想，因为 2·3∈(6)，而 2、3 均不在其中。
The prime ideals of ℤ are (0) and (p) for prime p. The ideal (6) fails because 2·3∈(6), while neither factor lies there.

title: 素理想对应整环商
Prime ideal ⇔ domain quotient
entries.tex: P\text{ prime}\iff R/P\text{ is a domain}
text: R 为有单位元的交换环时，P 为素理想当且仅当 R/P 为整环。真理想条件保证商环的 1 不等于 0。
For a commutative unital ring R, an ideal P is prime if and only if R/P is a domain. Properness ensures 1≠0 in the quotient.
proof: P 真，故商环非零且有单位元；交换性自动下降。
Properness makes the quotient nonzero and unital; commutativity descends.
[a][b]=0 等价于 ab∈P；素理想判别等价于 [a]=0 或 [b]=0，即商环无零因子。
The statement [a][b]=0 is equivalent to ab∈P. The prime-ideal condition says one class is zero, precisely the absence of zero-divisors.
反向若商环为整环，同样的等价关系给出素理想判别，且商环非零保证 P≠R。
Conversely, a nonzero domain quotient makes P proper, and the same equivalences prove primeness.

title: 极大不等于最大
Maximal does not mean greatest
entries.tex: M\subsetneq R,\quad M\subseteq J\lhd R\Rightarrow J=M\ \text{or}\ J=R
text: 极大理想是无法再扩大而仍保持真理想的理想；一个环可以有多个互不包含的极大理想。按教材，本节在交换环中讨论。
A maximal ideal cannot be enlarged while remaining proper. A ring can have several incomparable maximal ideals. This section follows the textbook’s commutative-ring setting.
example: ℤ₁₈ 中的 (2) 与 (3) 都极大，却互不包含；(6) 被它们严格包含，所以不极大。
In ℤ₁₈, (2) and (3) are both maximal and neither contains the other. The ideal (6) is contained strictly in both.

title: 极大理想对应域商
Maximal ideal ⇔ field quotient
entries.tex: M\text{ maximal}\iff R/M\text{ is a field}
text: R 为有单位元的交换环时，M 为极大理想当且仅当 R/M 为域。证明的核心是：a∉M 时，M+(a)=R 提供 [a] 的逆元。
For a commutative unital ring R, M is maximal exactly when R/M is a field. If a∉M, the equality M+(a)=R supplies the inverse of [a].
proof: 若 M 极大，对 a∉M 有 M⊊M+(a)，所以 M+(a)=R；写 1=m+ra。取商后 [r][a]=1。
If M is maximal and a∉M, then M+(a)=R. Write 1=m+ra; in the quotient [r][a]=1.
每个非零类都可逆，所以 R/M 为域。
Every nonzero class is invertible, so the quotient is a field.
反向若 R/M 为域而 M⊊J，取 a∈J∖M；存在 b 使 ab−1∈M⊆J，所以 1∈J，即 J=R。
Conversely, if the quotient is a field and M⊊J, choose a∈J∖M. An inverse class gives ab−1∈M⊆J, hence 1∈J and J=R.

title: 极大必素，但要保留单位元条件
Maximal implies prime, with hypotheses
text: 有单位元的交换环中，极大理想必为素理想，反之不成立。去掉单位元条件，正向也可能失败。
In a commutative unital ring every maximal ideal is prime, but not conversely. Without an identity even the forward implication can fail.
proof: 若 M 极大，则 R/M 是域，因而是整环，再由商环判别得 M 为素。
A maximal ideal has a field quotient, hence a domain quotient, so it is prime.
ℤ 中 (0) 为素理想，但被真理想 (2) 严格包含，不极大。
In ℤ, (0) is prime but not maximal, since (0)⊊(2)⊊ℤ.
在 2ℤ 中，4ℤ 的加法指数为 2，所以它极大；但 2∉4ℤ、2·2∈4ℤ，故不素。
In 2ℤ, the ideal 4ℤ has additive index 2 and is maximal, but is not prime because 2·2∈4ℤ with 2∉4ℤ.
warning: 先检查“交换且有单位元”，再使用极大理想与域商的对应。
Check commutativity and the identity before applying the field-quotient criterion.

title: 同一个多项式，在不同特征下
One polynomial, different characteristics
entries.tex: \mathbb F_3[x]/(x^2+1)\text{ is a field},\quad \mathbb F_2[x]/(x^2+1)\text{ is not}
text: 模 x²+1 取商后，每个类唯一写成 a+bθ，θ²=−1。在 𝔽₃ 上，八个非零类都有逆元；在 𝔽₂ 上，非零类 θ+1 的平方却是 0。
Modulo x²+1 each class is uniquely a+bθ with θ²=−1. Over 𝔽₃ all eight nonzero classes are invertible; over 𝔽₂ the nonzero class θ+1 squares to zero.
proof: 带余除法给出唯一的一次以下代表；若非零一次以下多项式属于 (x²+1)，次数会矛盾。
Division gives a unique representative of degree below 2; a nonzero multiple of x²+1 cannot have such degree.
在 𝔽₃ 中，非零平方只有 1，所以 (a,b)≠(0,0) 时 a²+b²≠0，逆元为 (a−bθ)/(a²+b²)。
In 𝔽₃ every nonzero square is 1. Thus a²+b²≠0 for (a,b)≠(0,0), giving inverse (a−bθ)/(a²+b²).
在 𝔽₂ 中，(θ+1)²=θ²+2θ+1=0，因此存在非零幂零元，不能是域。
In 𝔽₂, (θ+1)²=θ²+2θ+1=0. This nonzero nilpotent rules out a field.

question: ℤ 中哪个理想为素但不极大？
Which ideal of ℤ is prime but not maximal?
reason: The quotient ℤ is a domain but not a field.

question: ℤ₁₈ 的极大理想是哪一组？
Which are the maximal ideals of ℤ₁₈?
reason: 相应商环分别为 𝔽₂、𝔽₃；其他真理想的商有零因子。
Their quotients are 𝔽₂ and 𝔽₃; the other proper ideals have quotients with zero-divisors.

question: 在 𝔽₂[x]/(x²+1) 中，[x+1] 的平方是？
What is [x+1]² in 𝔽₂[x]/(x²+1)?
reason: (x+1)²=x²+1，属于被除去的理想，而 [x+1] 本身非零。
In characteristic 2, (x+1)²=x²+1 lies in the ideal; [x+1] itself is nonzero.

question: “极大理想必素”在本课中需要什么条件？
What hypotheses are used here for maximal ideals to be prime?
reason: 2ℤ 的极大理想 4ℤ 不素，说明单位元条件不能随意删掉。
The ideal 4ℤ is maximal but not prime in 2ℤ, so the identity hypothesis matters.

question: 设 R 有单位元且交换，M 极大，a∉M。构造 [a] 在 R/M 中的逆。
For a maximal ideal M in a commutative unital R and a∉M, construct the inverse of [a].
reason: M+(a) 真包含 M，因此等于 R。写 1=m+ra，m∈M、r∈R。取商得 1=[r][a]，故 [r] 为所求逆元。
Maximality makes M+(a)=R. Write 1=m+ra with m∈M; in the quotient [r][a]=1, giving the inverse.
